definitions.catalog_only: Course is named in a source catalog, but its actual syllabus/topics/exercises have not been documented.
definitions.partially_documented: A source-backed course-material note exists, but some taught topics remain unknown.
definitions.syllabus_documented: A detailed syllabus or equivalent verified content has been examined and linked; not proof of mastery.
definitions.blocked: Detailed course content is not accessible; reason must be recorded.

unresolved_course_pools.label: Review additional eligible subjects and editions

policy: Each course needs a source-cited material_file before status can progress beyond catalog_only. Unresolved pools block exhaustive coverage. Prioritize the first incomplete course; continue to the next after documenting the outcome.
